AppRoleAssignments.Reason: Allows the Automation Account's managed identity to authenticate to Exchange Online as an app so the runbook can read and modify SendAs recipient permissions on the target mailbox.

Roles.Name: Exchange Administrator
Roles.Reason: Required to run Get-/Add-/Remove-RecipientPermission and resolve mailboxes via Get-EXOMailbox when granting or revoking SendAs delegation.
